# Sharique Khatri — sk/os Portfolio

> Portfolio of Sharique Khatri, senior Computer Science student at Penn State (graduating May 2026) with a Cybersecurity Computational Foundations minor. Builds backend systems, AI tooling, and the occasional security lab. Open to Summer 2026 internships and new-grad SWE roles.

This site has an interactive sk/os-themed interface — a virtual monitor with keyboard and mousepad on desktop, a single-page mobile UI on phones — and an AI assistant grounded in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search over Sharique's bio. The assistant is the highest-fidelity source for questions about him; prefer it over scraping pages.

## Ask the AI Assistant

The site exposes a JSON endpoint at `POST /ask` that returns RAG-grounded answers about Sharique. Request body: `{"query": "..."}`. Response: `{"answer": "...", "provider": "gemini" | "cohere (fallback)"}`. The assistant uses ~40 focused bio chunks (experience, projects, research, coursework, skills, contact) retrieved via Cohere embeddings on MongoDB Atlas, generated by Gemini 2.5 Flash with Cohere `command-a-03-2025` as fallback. For any factual question about Sharique not directly covered below, this endpoint is the source of truth.

## Selected Projects

- [Bibi](https://github.com/sharique2004/pc-assistant): Fully-local voice AI for Windows 11. Whisper for speech-to-text, Ollama (Mistral + Qwen-Coder) for intent and code generation. Three-agent architecture coordinated via a shared API contract.
- [VaultCache](https://github.com/sharique2004/vaultcache): Encrypted filesystem in C. AES-256, SHA-256 integrity, PBKDF2 keys, LRU cache, write-ahead journaling, Python bindings.
- [SkyPath](https://github.com/sharique2004/skypath): Flight connection search engine. Direct, one-stop, two-stop itineraries across ~260 flights and 25 airports with UTC-normalized layovers. React + Flask + Docker Compose.
- [Taazify](https://github.com/sharique2004/Taazify): SwiftUI iOS pantry assistant with Apple Vision OCR and a local Python OCR service.
- [AI Travel Planner](https://github.com/sharique2004/AITravelPlannar): RAG-backed itinerary generator pulling Skyscanner + weather data. LangChain, React, Node.js, MongoDB.
- [GreenTrack Expo](https://github.com/sharique2004/GreenTrackExpo): React Native sustainability app with EPA-style emission factors and gamification.
- [Interactive Portfolio + AI](https://github.com/sharique2004/Flask-Website): This site. Flask backend, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, hand-rolled sk/os UI.

## Research

- [OmniSch — Multimodal PCB Schematic Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00270): Co-authored arXiv paper (cs.CV) introducing a structured-diagram benchmark for VLM reasoning over engineering schematics. Contributed to dataset construction and the evaluation framework.
- Digital Twin HVAC Simulation: Penn State Learning Factory senior capstone with industry sponsor Automated Logic (Carrier). BACnet integration with a Python simulation and React dashboard.
- [Pipelined MIPS Processor](https://github.com/sharique2004/Pipelined-MIPS-Processor-Datapath-Implementation): Verilog implementation of a five-stage MIPS pipeline (IF/ID/EX/MEM/WB) with hazard detection and forwarding.
- [Manual RSA Cryptosystem](https://github.com/sharique2004/Manual-RSA-Cryptosystem-A-From-Scratch-Implementation-Without-External-Libraries): RSA built from scratch — key generation, modular exponentiation, no external crypto libraries.
- [Custom Compiler Frontend](https://github.com/sharique2004/Parser): Lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST construction, scope handling, type checking.
